ai.title: Pope Leo Warns Artificial Intelligence Could Threaten Humanity
ai.description: Pope Leo XIV is throwing up a major warning flag about artificial intelligence ... saying the technology could become dangerous if nobody keeps it in check.

ai.title: BWSSB to host India’s first National AI and Digital Water Summit
ai.description: Bangalore Water Supply and Sewerage Board (BWSSB) said it will host India’s first and largest National AI and Digital Water Summit in Bengaluru on May 27 to discuss the use of artificial intelligence and digital technologies in urban water management with experts and policymakers.

ai.title: Pope Leo warns AI warfare 'not permissible' and autonomous weapons 'beyond human reach'
ai.description: Pope Leo has called for global regulation of artificial intelligence (AI) systems in his first encyclical, 'Magnifica Humanitas', warning it is "not permissible" to entrust AI with lethal decisions

ai.title: Global firms rethink GCC hiring in India as AI shifts skill demand
ai.description: Global firms in India are hiring cautiously. Artificial intelligence is changing job roles, making it harder to find talent with advanced tech skills. Companies seek specialized expertise in AI and cybersecurity. Entry-level positions may shrink as AI handles routine tasks. Re-skilling programs and university partnerships are underway to bridge the widening skills gap.

ai.title: Pope Leo terms AI a sin, says it may spark worldwide conflict
ai.description: Pope Leo XIV has unveiled his vision for the AI age in his first encyclical, urging governments to tighten oversight of artificial intelligence and restricting machines to make life-and-death decisions. He says AI should serve humanity rather than profit.
